sources.fact: Each stage first resets all requires_grad false, then enables selected attention/MLP modules.
Author hooks multiply selected weights gradient by neuron masks; gate/up/v use output-row masks, down/o use input-column masks; indices are filtered by actual dimension. q/k have no neuron mask.
Adapter records/removes original neuron-mask hooks and registers them before later weight gradient-right-multiply-by-P hooks.
Threshold S<=1e-6*max_eigenvalue first; when count below floor(.2*d), replaces selection by the smallest floor(.2*d) eigenvectors; P=Z Z.T.
Covariance/projectors derive from historical activations. No after_update method or post-step reapplication of mask/projector exists.

PaRSP.actual_hook_order: neuron mask, then grad @ P; column masks G M P, row masks R G P
missing_measurements: Actual optimizer deltaW and norm-matched directional descent
Measured M/P commutator, subspace intersection, numeric projector residual or actual support leakage

sources.fact: Top75% singular components frozen; low25% trainable factors. Every new stage refactors current reconstructed weight. post_backward projects factor gradients, after_update projects factor parameters.
Original code explicitly distinguishes gradient projection from parameter projection after Adam rescaling. This is an informative contrast, not evidence of actual PaRSP leakage.
Only SMoLoRA gets weight_decay .01. Actual PaRSP and OSFT groups use weight_decay0, eps1e-8, betas(.9,.999).
Stock AdamW step with moment transfers; no mask/projector repair in this optimizer.
Gradient clipping and logged preclip/postclip gradient norms occur after method gradient protection. after_update is invoked when a method defines it; PaRSP does not, OSFT does.

optimizer.stage_optimizer_state: Fresh optimizer/scheduler/scaler each stage in original training; do not invent cross-stage Adam momentum retention.

mathematical_condition.column_support: For a row update constrained both to coordinate support M of dimension m and an ideal P-subspace of rank r, generic intersection dimension is max(0,m+r-d).
caveats: Specific historical eigenspaces may align with selected coordinates and have a nonzero intersection.
GMP generally need not preserve M unless appropriate invariance/commutation holds; row masks are different.
Coordinatewise Adam preconditioning can change membership in P, but actual deltaW has not been measured here.
FP32 projector rank/idempotence properties were not measured; logged vector count is not a new numerical rank estimate.
